settings.heading: A note on what we do
settings.body: Prince Tires is a tire specialist. We sell and install tires, balance, rotate, repair punctures and service TPMS sensors at both our Calgary shops — but we don't perform wheel alignment, tire storage or mobile service. This article is here to help you understand the job; you'll need an alignment shop for the work itself.
